courses.title: Microbiology I
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLS 211 Microbiology I papers (2019/2020 exam, Quiz 1 marking scheme, and MLT 214 quizzes): staining, bacterial cell structure, microbial growth and nutrition, sterilization and disinfection, culture media, bacterial genetics, normal flora and introductory virology. Every question has a worked solution.

courses.title: Microbiology II
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLS 212 Microbiology II papers (2018/2019 exam and MLS 212B practical): principles of disease and epidemiology, pathogenicity and virulence, host defence, antimicrobial agents and resistance, specimen handling and culture media. Every question has a worked solution.

courses.title: Microbiology IV (Virology)
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLT 440 Microbiology IV papers (2017/2018): virus structure and classification, herpesviruses, hepatitis viruses, influenza and paramyxoviruses, enteroviruses, retroviruses and HIV, oncogenic viruses and diagnostic virology. Every question has a worked solution.

courses.title: Molecular Diagnostics
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLS 309A Molecular Diagnostics papers (2018/2019 and 2019/2020 exams, objectives quiz and restriction-mapping exercise): PCR and real-time PCR, nucleic acid extraction and quantitation, electrophoresis, hybridization and blotting, restriction enzymes and mapping, cloning vectors and DNA sequencing. Every question has a worked solution.

courses.title: Microbiology V (Mycology)
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLS 403A/B Microbiology V (Mycology) papers (2019/2020): classification of mycoses, superficial and cutaneous infections, dermatophytes, subcutaneous and systemic mycoses, opportunistic fungi, fungal allergy, mycotoxins and diagnostic mycology. Every question has a worked solution.

courses.title: Microbiology IV (Parasitology)
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast MLS 304A Microbiology IV (Parasitology) papers (2018/2019 sandwich exam): specimen collection, intestinal protozoa and amoebiasis, haemoflagellates, coccidia and toxoplasmosis, malaria diagnosis, intestinal nematodes, schistosomes and cestodes. Every question has a worked solution.
